gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic spaces its stroke ends far apart, so each letter lands on its own, with no heavy or light patches anywhere. Bellota Text is the commanding one, open-shaped and free of calligraphic shading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-orbit: Ruler-drawn lines, open counters, and a slow, one-letter-at-a-time beat. Bruno Ace earns its place big and short, while Orbit lets its curves stop short and each character float apart.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-syncopate: Bruno Ace SC strings its letters out like beads on a long thread, with open apertures and no calligraphic thinning. Syncopate adds technical-pen steadiness; the heading earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and open, its lowercase never squeezed shut. Bruno Ace SC spreads out like beads on a thread up top, a moderate lowercase against the taller one below.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-archivo: Horseshoe-wide c, diagonals that match the verticals: that's Cherry Swash. Archivo brings a taller lowercase and curves that open outward, a sturdy, editorial partner for the uniform-weight heading above.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Commanding Cherry Swash bends a horseshoe-wide c, while Be Vietnam Pro rides a high mean line on bent-steel strokes. Let the heading go big and the body stay modest.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-ranade: Cherry Swash draws a horseshoe-wide c in blunt, marker-round strokes. Ranade, a sans with a slight stretched-rubber shift in weight and widely spaced letters, makes the gentlest foil for that bluntness.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-orbit: Big, blunt, horseshoe-open lettering up top, every diagonal matching the verticals exactly. Cherry Swash commands attention, and Orbit does its best work letting each rope-steady character float apart.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-alexandria: Expressive Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of uniform width. Alexandria meets it with a tall body, short stems and generously opened terminals, so the page feels spacious and lively.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Commanding Funnel Display holds a round bowl whose outline never swells or thins. And Anek Gurmukhi softens the mood with generous counters in every small letter and open-handed curves.
